Accomplishment

1. Solo Art Exhibition “Capturing Memories” at Amerasia Bank Gallery, NY, Apr. 24-May 5, 2015

2. Oil painting “Taiwan’s Xiaoyu Watermelon” won the third prize from the New Rochelle Art Association’s Jules Bauer Award Show. June 2015.

3. Oil painting “National Theater of Taiwan” won the HM prize from the New Rochelle Art Association’s Jules Bauer Award Show. June 2015.

4. Oil painting “The Hsu Family Ensemble” was featured in New Rochelle Art Association’s online-gallery.

5. 2014 Dec. Oil painting “Stretching Out to the Sky” won the second prize from the New Rochelle Art Association’s Adolph Grant Award Show
